items.name: Potion of Invisibility
items.description:
The creature or object touched becomes invisible. If the recipient is a creature carrying gear, that vanishes, too. If you cast the spell on someone else, neither you nor your allies can see the subject, unless you can normally see invisible things or you employ magic to do so.

items.name: Ring of Protection +1
items.description: This ring offers continual magical protection in the form of a deflection bonus of +1 to +5 to AC.

items.name: Tools, Thieves' (Masterwork)
items.description:
This kit contains lockpicks and other tools you need to use the @Compendium[pf1.skills.CCy1fajKKU3K02iQ]{Disable Device} skill. Without these tools, you must use improvised tools, and you take a -2 circumstance penalty on @Compendium[pf1.skills.CCy1fajKKU3K02iQ]{Disable Device} checks.

This kit contains extra tools and tools of better make, which grant a +2 circumstance bonus on @Compendium[pf1.skills.CCy1fajKKU3K02iQ]{Disable Device} checks.

items.name: Backpack, Masterwork
items.description: This backpack has numerous pockets for storing items that might be needed while adventuring. Hooks are included for attaching items such as canteens, pouches, or even a rolled-up blanket. It has padded bands that strap across the chest and the waist to distribute its weight more evenly. Like a common backpack, it can hold about 2 cubic feet of material in its main container. items.name: Potion of Cure Moderate Wounds
items.description: This spell functions like cure light wounds, except that it cures 2d8 points of damage + 1 point per caster level (maximum +10).

items.name: Amulet of Natural Armor +1
items.description: This amulet, usually containing some type of magically preserved monster hide or other natural armor—such as bone, horn, carapace, or beast scales—toughens the wearer’s body and flesh, giving him an enhancement bonus to his natural armor from +1 to +5, depending on the kind of amulet.

items.name: Cloak of Resistance +1
items.description: This garment offers magic protection in the form of a +1 to +5 resistance bonus on all saving throws (Fortitude, Reflex, and Will).

items.name: Sexy Chain Shirt
items.description: Covering the torso, this shirt is made up of thousands of interlocking metal rings.

items.name: Potion of Disguise Self
items.description:
You make yourself--including clothing, armor, weapons, and equipmen--look different. You can seem 1 foot shorter or taller, thin, fat, or in between. You cannot change your creature type (although you can appear as another subtype). Otherwise, the extent of the apparent change is up to you. You could add or obscure a minor feature or look like an entirely different person or gender.
